privacy_measurement_contract.unique_qualified_human_session: Use approved first-party aggregated sessions and bot filtering; no invented person-level identification
privacy_measurement_contract.asset_id: Only authenticated published creator media ID; for YouTube profile utm_content=yt_profile, not video ID
privacy_measurement_contract.metric: 1000 * (cleared commissions or net owned receipts minus reversals, direct fees, refunds) / unique qualified human sessions; report NOT COMPUTABLE when numerator/denominator missing
privacy_measurement_contract.data_minimization: Aggregate campaign + source + authenticated asset ID + anonymous conversion counts where consent and policy allow; never copy emails, names or payment details into analytics.

experiment.hypothesis: An optional original short film may change the rate of independently verified paid transactions relative to an equivalent text-only guide; no assumption it increases conversions.
experiment.treatment: Variant B has static 42s video storyboard only until encoded media is produced
experiment.randomization: requires separate approved deterministic first-party anonymous allocation; not implemented
experiment.outcome: merchant-confirmed paid orders; refund-adjusted net revenue per 1000 qualified human sessions
experiment.secondary: provider-confirmed lead only if consent verified
experiment.decision_rule: Do not launch A/B before both versions are accessible, privacy-reviewed and partner-authorized; avoid small-sample winning claims.
